body:
[Erowid Note: 
While the author reported the substance used as 5-MeO-DMT, they seem to conflate NN-DMT and 5-MeO-DMT. These substances have different effects and dosages. Most often the error made is that the term "DMT" is used as shorthand to refer to 5-Methoxy-DMT. However, because of the ambiguity in the substance name, it is uncertain whether the author is speaking about 5-MeO-DMT throughout this report or not. See
5-MeO-DMT is Not "DMT"
.]
I've read a lot about DMT and decided that I want to try it, so I inquired a friend about getting some. He did so and I purchased a fairly large amount. I had no scale, so I 'eyeballed' the amount when loading the bowl. This was not a smart idea, but turned out to be perfect. I was with four of my best friends, and we had just won the district soccer game for our school - putting me in a very grand mood. We smoked a blunt and a bowl of some decent schwag, so we were a little goofy. I turned off the lights, turned on a play-list I had created for this trip, and loaded the bowl. It is a small glass water-pipe that I just use for marijuana, and I put a few small nugs of dro in the bowl, speckled chopped up bits of dro on top of that, and then put the DMT on the very top.
I just put what looked like a good enough amount for me to trip. I was generous, but not stupid. I sat on the couch next to a window, mentally prepared and took a few deep breathes, held the lighter a half-inch above the bowl and inhaled. I took the largest rip I could and held it in the longest I could. I exhaled and immediately attempted another hit. I got half-way through before my friend had to take the pipe out of my hand and I sat back to enjoy. There's no way to fully prepare for an adventure like this, but I tried. The head-rushes came in waves, pounding my brain. I could feel myself going further and further away, and then I was gone. I could tell my friends were in the room, but communicating with them was almost impossible. I floated through the dreamlike state of being any profession I wanted, and going anywhere I wanted.
At ten for 15 minutes in I began to peak and had a small religious experience. The jokes my friends made had an effect on me and I laughed harder than I ever have before. I reflected on various stages of my life, imagining and living them vividly. I had both CEV's and OEV's. At 20 minutes I thought to come down from this, but the time was not right. I continued on this journey for 40 minutes, surprisingly long. I was starving, merely from the weed, but enjoying ever minute of this adventure.
I proceeded to kick a soccer ball and went upside down for a while doing gymnastics, as well as enduring a Star Wars epic due to the ring-tone that went off while I was tripping. All in all this has been one of my favorite experiences, and I deem myself a fairly experienced recreational user of various substances, MDMA/LSD/Cannabis/Psilocybin Mushrooms/Tobacco/Salvia etc...
This has been the highest point of amazement and beauty, and I loved every second of it.
